claim_summary: CHEAR constructs a validated activity-confusion hierarchy and pairwise sensor-feature evidence offline, then uses retrieval-conditioned LLM decisions to retain candidates and select a human activity label online.

claim_evidence.quote: We propose confusionhierarchy evidence-aware reasoning (CHEAR), which moves part of this knowledge organization

modules.name: Validated activity-confusion hierarchy construction
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK applies because the hierarchy groups activity labels using HAR classification errors; changing the task family changes the label objective and hierarchy. It has no task-independent temporal state or availability semantics (R3_2_GTS counterfactual), and is not generic execution state (R3_3_GH).
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - hierarchy is built from activity classification confusions

evidence.quote: The independent source validation set may select only candidates on these paths whose gain over the all-singleton partition is strictly positive; it cannot introduce a structure absent from construction.

modules.name: Confusion-hierarchy variable-size candidate retention
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK applies because the LLM retains activity-label candidates to produce one HAR class; another task objective would require different candidate units and output selection. Retrieval evidence is not temporal state management independent of that objective (R3_2_GTS counterfactual), and this is more specific than generic runtime control (R3_3_GH).
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - retention selects among activity classification labels

evidence.quote: target dataset’s position-specific reference stores. Inference starts from root candidate units. Given the current candidates and retrieval evidence, the LLM retains a variablesize subset.

modules.name: On-demand activity-pair feature knowledge
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK applies because each report compares registered activity-label endpoints and informs class selection; changing task families changes the endpoints and validation objective. Although the report computes temporal features, it has no task-independent temporal scope (R3_2_GTS counterfactual); it is not generic harness state (R3_3_GH).
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - pair reports compare activity classification endpoints

reconciliation.reason: The pairwise report remains a contributed task-specific mechanism. It computes temporal features, but its endpoint-bound comparison serves activity classification rather than a task-independent temporal function view.
